title: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
title_zh: MFlowHOI：基于部件感知 MeanFlow 的全身体物交互生成

paragraphs.en: MFlowHOI 是一种高效的一步式生成全身体物交互的框架，通过接触感知多部件 RVQVAE 和 ST-DiT 模型实现。 Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.
paragraphs.zh: MFlowHOI 是一种高效的一步式生成全身体物交互的框架，通过接触感知多部件 RVQVAE 和 ST-DiT 模型实现。全身体物交互（HOI）的生成需要协调身体和手指的运动、物体的轨迹以及随时间变化的接触点。 现有方法通常依赖迭代扩散或测试时优化，导致推理成本高昂。 由于推理效率高，直接的一步式生成在下游应用中备受青睐。 然而，这极具挑战性，因为这些 HOI 组件在结构和规模上存在显著差异。 我们提出了 MFlowHOI，一种用于全身体物交互生成的高效一步式框架。 一种接触感知多部件 RVQVAE 将身体、手、物体和接触信号组织为结构化的潜在空间，并通过共享解码器保持其全局协调性。 随后，ST-DiT 在该空间中建模时间依赖性和跨部件依赖关系，并在单次 MeanFlow 评估中生成完整的交互。 预测的物体局部接触对应关系进一步支持了几何细节的优化，并可将交互特性迁移到具有不同身体比例的超真实 3D 高斯化身模型中。 实验表明，MFlowHOI 在运动质量和文本对齐方面优于现有的基础生成器，同时显著缩短了推理时间。
